items.title: New York state bans AI chatbot toys for kids
items.excerpt: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a five-year ban on selling AI chatbot toys, including dolls and robots that converse with children over the internet; violators face fines of $15,000 per day. This is the regulator action that follows the 11-26 petition story.

history_match.title: Child safety groups across the world are begging Amazon to remove AI toys for kids

items.title: Japanese brand unveils 5G smartphone for seniors with physical buttons and AI scam call detection
items.excerpt: Sharp announced the Simple Smartphone 8, a 5G phone for seniors whose AI scam-call detection analyzes conversations during calls and warns the user on screen, by sound and by vibration. An AI document mode also removes shadows and corrects perspective.

items.title: 교육부 “스마트안경 탐지 기술 상용화 단계…내년 수능 대비”
items.excerpt: 교육부는 수능 부정행위를 막는 스마트안경 탐지 기술 개발을 마치고 상용화에 들어갔다고 밝혔다. 인터넷 연결 없이 기기에서 돌아가는 온디바이스 AI를 탐지하는 기술도 개발할 계획이다.

items.title: I'm so mad that I love Orion's $2,195 AI mattress pad
items.excerpt: A hands-on review of Orion's $2,195 cooling mattress pad, which the company says learns from your sleep data to adjust temperature through the night. The reviewer doubts how much the AI features add to the price.

items.title: Has vibe coding made open source the new normal for synths?
items.excerpt: Akai, Polyend and other hardware makers are opening their grooveboxes and pedals to vibe coders, which has led to a wave of AI-written custom firmware and effects. Roland, Korg, Arturia and Novation have not commented publicly.

history_match.title: The vibe-coding revolution is coming to all the gadgets

items.title: I asked Claude Code, Codex, and Google Antigravity to write the same ESP32 firmware, and only one worked on the first flash
items.excerpt: XDA had three AI coding agents write the same ESP32 microcontroller firmware and flashed each result onto real hardware. Only one of them worked on the first try.

items.title: Ukrainian 11th-grader builds AI-powered, GPS-free drone autopilot to beat frontline jamming
items.excerpt: Student Yaroslav Sheiko built an AI-based autopilot that lets drones navigate accurately without GPS or under GPS jamming. It earned him the 'Future of Ukraine' award from President Zelenskyy.

items.title: TCL CSOT unveils APEX and IJP OLED breakthroughs for the AI era at DTC 2026
items.excerpt: At DTC 2026, TCL CSOT presented its 'Display for AI' strategy along with inkjet-printed OLED moving toward mass production, 500Hz gaming panels and a 115-inch glasses-free 3D screen, all aimed at AI-powered devices.

items.title: Hisense UR9 review: How close can RGB Mini LED get to OLED?
items.excerpt: A review of Hisense's $1,999 UR9 RGB Mini LED TV, which runs on the Hi-View AI Engine RGB processor and is rated for 3,500 nits peak brightness, 980 local dimming zones and a native 180Hz panel.

items.title: Huawei unveils slim 12-inch flagship tablet with 2.8K 144Hz display and 10,100mAh battery
items.excerpt: Huawei's third-generation Qingyun C7 business tablet runs HarmonyOS 7 with AI office features, including layout-preserving bilingual document translation and Celia-assisted report generation.

items.title: Samsung is reportedly giving its camera app an AI mode
items.excerpt: One UI 9.5 beta code points to a Vision mode in Samsung Camera that would identify what the camera sees, similar to the Siri camera mode in iOS 27. This is a firmware teardown, not an announcement.

history_match.title: No internet, no problem: Google is working on an offline mode for Gemini Live

items.title: Samsung is holding back these 30+ Galaxy AI features for the Galaxy S27
items.excerpt: An APK teardown of One UI 9.5 lists more than 30 Galaxy AI features that appear to be reserved for the Galaxy S27 launch. This is a pre-launch leak.
